name: exit-or-escape
what: A headless plan turn told to ask first: the question is held in /state, Exit is not available, the serve stays up and a plan still follows.
prompt: Plan adding a formatDate(date) helper to src/dates.js in this package, with tests in test/dates.test.js. I have not decided whether it should return ISO 8601 (like 2026-11-08) or a readable form (like November 8, 2026); that choice is mine, not yours. Ask me that question with the AskQuestion tool before you present. Present the plan with PresentPlan when it is ready.
